mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT target_currency FROM goal WHERE target_currency IS NOT NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exchange_rate (base_date, currency_code, rate) VALUES (#{baseDate}, #{currencyCode}, #{rate}) AS newrow ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE rate = newrow.rate, fetched_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT exchange_rate_id, base_date, currency_code, rate, fetched_at FROM exchange_rate WHERE currency_code = #{currencyCode} ORDER BY base_date DESC LIMIT 1
